[quote=oceanice_republics;60096353][Spoiler=[i][u][b]Council of Ten Session *Top Secret*[/b][/u][/i]]

[i][b]100  Public Overseer [/b]
 Council, we convene to address the ULR proposal for a joint naval operation in the Argos Strait. Piracy in the region threatens both our exports and their own. This is the formal hearing before resolution.

[b]070  Foreign Liaison Overseer[/b]
 Given the global distraction of the Kaiserreich-THEP war, this is an opportunity for mutual benefit. A years truce, combined patrols. It projects stability, and

[b]020  Valder Dark (Supreme Military Overseer)[/b] *tail curling against the floor*
 It projects weakness. ULR warships alongside ours? Sharing command protocols? A naive risk. I will not have Oceanice captains taking orders from foreign admirals.

[b]010  Vanklyis (Executive President Overseer)[/b] *leaning forward, voice sharp*
 This isnt about your pride, Valder. Its about keeping the Strait secure so our shipping doesnt choke. Equal partnership is the only way this works. Unless, of course, youd rather let pirates bleed our treasury just to feed your ego.

[b]Valder Dark[/b] *owo growl, claws tapping the table*
 Careful, Vanklyis. I speak for the defense of the Republic, not for myself. But perhaps you wouldnt understand, youve never commanded a fleet under fire.

[b]Vanklyis[/b] *slamming his palm on the table*
 No, what I understand is that furries dont belong in a seat of the Council in the first place! This room was built for those who put the Republic above their species, and all youve done is drag your primitive biases into policy!

*A sharp intake of breath is heard from several Overseers. The hum of the air system feels louder in the silence that follows.*

[b]Valder Dark[/b] *tail lashing, eyes narrowing to slits*
 You speak of bias while spitting venom in my face? I have defended this Republic with my blood while youve hidden behind your titles.

[b]Vanklyis[/b] *leaning closer*
 And yet, here you are, demanding we reject cooperation because you cannot stomach working alongside anyone outside your narrow military pride. You disgrace this room.

[b]030  Intelligence Director [/b]
 If I maythis arrangement offers an intelligence windfall. D.S.I. can operate under the joint patrol cover, mapping ULR naval logistics, intercepting their encrypted traffic. The pirates are the bait; the real catch is their military network.

[b]040  Economic & Banking Overseer[/b]
 And without action, trade losses will devalue the Oceanice Mark. If the pirates are left unchecked, we lose more than face; we cant lose economic leverage over our allies.

*Valder opens his mouth to reply, but the lights in the room subtly brighten* 

[b]000  Supreme Overseer [/b]
 Enough. This Council does not fracture over bloodlines or fur. Valder Dark is a valued asset, and his caution has preserved the Republic in darker hours than these. Vanklyis, your conduct approaches insubordination to this body.

[b]000  Supreme Overseer[/b]
 The operation will proceed under shared command. The Council will oversee all orders. Neither of you will undermine this decision, nor will species be a matter of policy again in this room.

[b]Valder Dark[/b] *bowing head slightly*
 As the Council wills.

[b]Vanklyis[/b] *tight, begrudging nod*
 Understood.

[b]000  Supreme Overseer[/b]
 The directive will be issued as Policy A-S41/Argos. D.S.I., proceed with your parallel objectives. This meeting never happened. Dismissed.[/i]

[quote=oceanice_republics;60091958]The Oceanice Republic acknowledges receipt of the United Lavian Republics proposal regarding enhanced maritime security operations within the Argos Strait. We recognize the growing threat posed by piracy in the region and the risks such instability poses to international shipping, economic security, and the logistical networks upon which both our nations depend.

In this emerging threat, we will help cooperation and mutual economic interest, the Oceanice Republic agrees to participate in a Joint Naval Security Mission with the United Lavian Republic. We believe in signing the Terms of Agreement. 

In the agreement, a One-Year Truce, both nations agree to suspend hostilities for 12 months. Mutual Naval access to each others territorial waters for anti-piracy operations. A Joint Command to ensure equal representation in a combined naval operational command. Unified Patrol Zone to full coverage of the Argos Strait without territorial restrictions. Resource Pooling, we will ensure backup support from our ships, aircraft, and logistics assets. A joint Intelligence Sharing to secure real-time communications and coordinated threat response. The Agreement is reviewed after 12 months for both sides, easing our rivalry tensions.  [/quote]

The Lavian government accepts these terms, and will begin organizing troops for the operation shortly.

Basic information: Pirates from Argos and East Shamat have been targeting shipping lanes in the Argos Straight. 

Tactics: These pirates will commonly board large cargo ships using grappling hooks and ladders, using speedboats to approach quickly and shooting in the air to frighten and intimidate the crew, sometimes even firing at the superstructure of the ship. They will often hold these ships hostage, even forcing the crew ashore and holding them there for as long as they need to get a ransom. 

They have recently been using motherships, ships which the leaders of these pirates have purchased and use as a floating base. These ships are used to receive captives, send out false SOS signals, as well as carry and resupply the speedboats they use to attack ships.

Post 1:

[i]In the middle of the argos straight, a oil tanker breaks through the water at a crisp pace, operating as normal as can be. That is until it is boarded by pirates and a transmission is sent. It's a demand for a ransom of $3M. A notification is quickly sent to the Lavian navy, the nation which the ship originates from. Responding quickly, a destroyer is sent to track down the ship before the pirates realize that an SOS was sent.[/i]

Two days later, The destroyer spots the ship, with another near it. It's a mothership, which if destroyed would be a massive blow to this pirate crew. They can't just open fire though, they don't know if there are hostages on there and they need to be tactical. As they get closer, pirates begin panicking and spraying bursts of gunfire towards the military ship. This ineffective show of force only allows navy riflemen to begin picking off the pirates as they get ever closer. Eventually, The destroyer gets close enough to deploy a boarding party of their own, departing in small RHIBs and using grappling hooks to board and take over the mother ship themselves. Firefights ensue, with the servicemen making quick work of the pirates on the mothership. The only complication is when a pirate attempted to use an improvised rocket propelled grenade, accidentally dropping the explosive and tearing a hole in the deck to a lower floor. 

As this happens, teams also sweep the oil tanker and eliminate the few pirates they see. The only pirates that do surrender are the ones which were guarding the captives as they had enough time to reason that they had no other chance at survival. Freeing the crew and taking the prisoners back to the destroyer, the military commandeers the mothership and escorts the tanker and bring the mothership to a safe port. They quickly turn the ship over to military intelligence, allowing a vast overview of how pirate motherships look, operate, as well as the history of the ship. This is a large gain to anti-piracy operations, and the information learned will be shared with the Ocenaice Republic and international entities.

GDP: Gross Domestic Product. A measure of the total market value of all final goods and services produced within a country's borders in a specific time period, usually a year.

GDP per capita: A measure of the total economic output of a country (Gross Domestic Product) divided by the number of people living there. It indicates the average value of goods and services produced per person, and is often used as a gauge of a country's economic prosperity and standard of living.

[quote=oceanice_republics;60100790][i][u][b]Oceanice Republic Naval Command Center, aboard the flagship destroyer ORS Valhalla.[/b][/u]

[b]-Argos Strait-[/b]

Commander Elena Dravik stood over the tactical map table, eyes sharp and voice steady as she addressed her officers. Weve received actionable intelligence from our Delta Special Intelligence unit, reports that pirate motherships near the eastern corridor are preparing to launch another raid on commercial shipping lanes.

Her deputy, Lieutenant Commander Ryven, nodded. White Seal Special OPS teams are on standby for boarding and hostage rescue. Patrol boats are deployed in a perimeter to intercept fast-attack craft. The Valhalla and accompanying destroyers will establish a no-fly, no-sail zone until the area is secured.

Draviks tone hardened. Our priority is dismantling these pirate bases and rescuing hostages with minimal risk to innocent crews. Coordination with the Lavian Navy and international allies ensures the sharing of real-time intelligence. Any signs of false SOS signals or disguised pirate vessels are to be treated as hostile.

Minutes later, the command center erupted in activity. Radar operators tracked multiple fast boats racing toward a large vessel, suspected to be a mothership. The White Seal operatives readied their gear, checking weapons and boarding equipment. Remote-controlled drones fed live visuals to the command center, highlighting pirate movements on deck.
Deploy RHIBs, Dravik ordered. Silent approach, full stealth. Remember, the lives of those aboard depend on precision.

The boarding party moved swiftly through the moonlit waves, grappling hooks flying as they ascended onto the motherships deck. Close-quarters combat broke out, with the elite White Seal operatives neutralizing threats while searching for hostages.

Simultaneously, patrol boats intercepted incoming speedboats, cutting off reinforcements and capturing stragglers.
Hours later, as dawn broke over the Argos Strait, the mothership was secured. Hostages were freed, and pirate captives were taken into custody. Intelligence teams immediately began examining the mothership for clues about pirate operations.

Commander Dravik exhaled deeply, eyes scanning the horizon. This is more than a battle at sea. Its a statement. The Oceanice Republic will not tolerate threats to maritime security. We will continue to hunt these pirates until every shipping lane is safe.[/i]
